## Hinge question · Reading a multiplier {#ss8-hinge .growth-lesson .sequence-hinge .growth-hinge}

```{=html}
<div data-module="hinge" data-correct="4" class="hinge numeric-choices"><p class="hinge-question">Multiplying a quantity by <span data-math="0.82">0.82</span> results in:</p><div class="hinge-toolbar"><div class="time" role="timer" aria-label="Time remaining">1:00</div><div class="toolbar"><label>Seconds <select class="timer-duration" aria-label="Question duration"><option>30</option><option>45</option><option selected>60</option><option>90</option><option>120</option></select></label><button class="timer-start primary">Start</button><button class="reset-question">Reset</button></div></div><div class="choices"><button class="choice" data-answer="1" aria-pressed="false"><b>1</b><span>An 82% increase.</span></button><button class="choice" data-answer="2" aria-pressed="false"><b>2</b><span>An 18% increase.</span></button><button class="choice" data-answer="3" aria-pressed="false"><b>3</b><span>An 82% decrease.</span></button><button class="choice" data-answer="4" aria-pressed="false"><b>4</b><span>An 18% decrease.</span></button></div><div class="hinge-bottom"><p>Fist on chest. Think quietly. On “show”, hold up 1–4 fingers.</p><button class="reveal-answer primary">Reveal answer</button></div><div class="hinge-explanation" hidden>4. 82% of the original remains, so the decrease is <span data-math="100\%-82\%=18\%">100\%-82\%=18\%</span>.</div></div>
```

::: notes

Default 60 seconds, with adjustable duration, start/pause/reset and separate answer reveal. Fist on chest. Think quietly. On the teacher’s verbal “show”, hold up 1–4 fingers simultaneously. Timer expiry must not reveal the answer. Correct answer 4: multiplying by 0.82 retains 82%, so the decrease is 18%. Choice 1 mistakes 82% retained for an 82% increase. Choice 2 reverses the direction while correctly identifying the 18% difference. Choice 3 confuses the percentage retained with the percentage removed. Ready: ask for the multiplier for an 18% increase (1.18), then proceed. Divided: apply 0.82 to an initial 100 and re-poll. Reteach: write 100→82, calculate the 18-unit change and reconnect to 18%. This is the single-factor hinge from Year 10 Financial Mathematics Lesson 1.

:::
